supporting_observations.claim: User ivy.chen used PowerShell to compress a directory from the file server into a local zip archive
User ivy.chen accessed a file-sharing website quickshare-drop.net using Google Chrome
A large outbound data transfer of approximately 51 MB was sent from WS-ICHEN-01 to quickshare-drop.net via the proxy
The user staged data from a corporate file share and exfiltrated it to an unapproved external file-sharing service

unrelated_findings: Presence of Cisco AnyConnect VPN software (T039-00190) and Zscaler tunnel (T039-00264) which are not listed in the approved services inventory.
